help.title: Workshop guide
help.library.q: How do I browse or download pets?
help.library.a: Scroll over the pet library to browse horizontally. Hover over a card to read its name. Longer names scroll automatically. Select a card with a cloud icon and confirm to download it. Select the same card again to cancel the download.
help.manage.q: How do I rename or delete a pet?
help.manage.a: Double-click an owned pet's card, enter a new name, and save. The same dialog lets you delete the pet. Confirm deletion to remove its card from the library.
help.text.q: How do I create a portrait from text?
help.text.a: Select New pet and open the text-to-portrait tab. Describe the character, choose how many candidates you want, and confirm. The dice fills in random traits. Candidates appear automatically when generation finishes. Select the portrait you like and save it.
help.upload.q: How do I upload an existing image?
help.upload.a: Open the portrait-to-motion tab. Click the dashed box or drop up to four images onto it, with a limit of 64 MiB per image. Confirm to move them to the candidate list on the right. The default pet name comes from the filename without its extension.
help.portrait.q: How do I adjust an uploaded portrait?
help.portrait.a: Select an image in the candidate list, click Edit, and describe the change. Each edit uses one portrait credit. The result joins the existing candidates, so you can compare them and save your favorite.
help.motion.q: How do I generate the first actions or add more?
help.motion.a: Save a portrait, select the pet, and choose the actions you want in the left list. The first generation includes Idle. Confirm the credit cost to begin. New actions are saved automatically when they are ready.
help.preview.q: How do I preview actions or zoom in?
help.preview.a: Select any available action in the left list to play it. Select a portrait candidate to see the image. Scroll over the preview to zoom. Selecting another action or portrait resets the zoom.
help.edit.q: How do I change an existing action or cancel the edit?
help.edit.a: Select an available action, click Edit, and describe the change. Preview the result and click Install action to replace it. To keep the original action, click Cancel and confirm that you want to discard the changes.
help.enable.q: How do I put the pet on my desktop?
help.enable.a: Select a pet that has an Idle action, then click Enable pet. After installing an action edit, you can enable the updated pet here as well.
help.tasks.q: How do I check, resume, or cancel a task?
help.tasks.a: The workshop refreshes progress automatically. You can also refresh it manually. Reopen the workshop to continue tracking the same task, or recover the original request if its reply was lost. You can request cancellation while a task is running. Completed generation may still use credits.
help.credits.q: How do credits work, and how do I get more?
help.credits.a: Creating or adjusting portraits uses portrait credits. Creating or editing actions uses motion credits. Your balance is in the upper right. Open Get credits to redeem a code or to visit MoeGuard's Afdian page for a code.
help.mail.q: How do I report a workshop issue or view a reply?
help.mail.a: Use the feedback link at the top of this guide to open the mailbox. Write a message and confirm sending. You can read replies in the conversation tab and updates in Announcements.
